links.outcome: Identification of training participants from reconstructed retinal images via gradient inversion attack in federated learning
links.effect: Across all models, over 92% of training-set participants could be identified from reconstructed retinal vessel structure alone; with differential privacy, substantial information could still be extracted.
links.quote: Experimental results for the task of retinal age prediction demonstrate that, across all models, over 92 % of the participants in the training set could be identified from their reconstructed retinal vessel structure alone.

unlisted_practices: Differential privacy as a defense against gradient inversion in federated learning
